title: Rob Lowe Says ‘St. Elmo’s Fire’ Sequel Is Still ‘In the Works,’ Confirms There’s a Script: ‘All of Us Actors Want to Do It’
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Rob Lowefinally has an update on the long-discussed “St. Elmo’s Fire” sequel.

“It is definitely in the works, for sure,” the actor said when asked about the project’s current status during a “Watch What Happens Live” appearance on Sunday. “All of us actors want to do it, and we’re supposed to get a draft of the script the first week of October.”

While Lowe didn’t give much away, the news that the sequel is making progress is the latest update fans of the 1985 classic have been waiting on since the film was first announced in 2024. The“Parks and Recreation” actortoldEntertainment Tonightthat he’d “met with the studio” and had “been talking about doing it for about four months.” “But it’s very, very, very, very, very early stages,” he added. “So we will see.”

That same year, Lowe’s “St. Elmo’s Fire” co-starDemi Moore saidthat “conversations are happening” around the sequel and revealed that discussions were underway with Sony, the same studio behind the original film. She also said the studio was “really behind [and] driving this,” though they were still “looking for the right partner” to write it.

Varietypreviously reported that NBC was developing a series adaptation of the film back in 2019, though it never materialized. Josh Berman had been attached to write and executive produce along with Chris King. At the time, the series was described as a modern adaptation of the film that showcases a group of close friends struggling with career, commitment and the responsibilities of adulthood.

Released in 1985, “St. Elmo’s Fire” starred Lowe, Moore, Emilio Estevez, Andrew McCarthy, Ally Sheedy, Judd Nelson and others. Joel Schumacher directed and co-wrote the script with Carl Kurlander.
title_zh: 羅布·勞(Rob Lowe)表示《聖艾爾摩的火焰》(St. Elmo's Fire)續集仍在籌備中，並確認已經有劇本：“我們所有的演員都想參與這個項目。”
content_zh:
由佩頓·圖克塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

羅布·洛(Rob Lowe)終於對長期討論的《聖艾爾摩之火》(St. Elmo’s Fire)續集有了最新消息。

“這確實在進行中，毫無疑問，”這位演員在週日的《看發生了什麼直播》(Watch What Happens Live)節目中被問及該項目的當前狀態時表示。“我們所有的演員都想參與這個項目，我們預計在十月的第一週會收到劇本的初稿。”

雖然洛並沒有透露太多細節，但續集進展的消息是自2024年首次宣布該電影以來，1985年經典影片的粉絲們一直在期待的最新消息。這位《公園與休閒》(Parks and Recreation)演員告訴《娛樂今夜》(Entertainment Tonight)他已經“與製片廠會面”，並且“已經討論了大約四個月”。他補充道：“但這仍然是非常非常非常非常非常早期的階段。所以我們拭目以待。”

同年，洛的《聖艾爾摩之火》共演德米·摩爾(Demi Moore)表示，關於續集的“對話正在進行中”，並透露與索尼(Sony)的討論正在進行中，索尼是原始電影的製片廠。她還表示，該製片廠“非常支持並推動這個項目”，儘管他們仍在“尋找合適的合作夥伴”來撰寫劇本。

《綜藝》(Variety)早前報導，NBC在2019年曾開發該電影的系列改編，但最終並未實現。喬什·伯曼(Josh Berman)曾被聘請負責編劇和執行製作，與克里斯·金(Chris King)合作。當時，該系列被描述為一部現代改編的電影，展示了一群親密朋友在事業、承諾和成年責任中掙扎的故事。

《聖艾爾摩之火》於1985年上映，主演包括洛、摩爾、艾米利奧·艾斯特維茲(Emilio Estevez)、安德魯·麥卡錫(Andrew McCarthy)、艾莉·希迪(Ally Sheedy)、賈德·尼爾森(Judd Nelson)等。喬爾·舒馬赫(Joel Schumacher)執導並與卡爾·庫蘭德(Carl Kurlander)共同編劇。
